source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the preparation of carboxylic acids (PDF 108-110).

items: Primary alcohols aur aldehydes ki oxidation: shuruati maadde ko zaid tezaabi KMnO4 ya K2Cr2O7 ke saath reflux par garam kiya jata hai: CH3CH2OH + 2[O] -> CH3COOH + H2O; CH3CHO + [O] -> CH3COOH.

Nitriles ki hydrolysis: tezaab mein nitriles seedhe carboxylic acids dete hain, CH3CN + 2H2O + HCl -> CH3COOH + NH4Cl; alkali mein pehle namak dete hain, CH3CN + H2O + NaOH -> CH3COONa + NH3, jo tezaab milane par tezaab deta hai, CH3COONa + HCl -> CH3COOH + NaCl.

Esters ki hydrolysis: halke tezaab ke saath reflux se tezaab aur alcohol bante hain, CH3COOCH2CH3 + H2O <=> CH3COOH + CH3CH2OH (H3O+); halki alkali se carboxylate namak banta, CH3COOCH2CH3 + NaOH -> CH3COONa + CH3CH2OH, aur tezaab milane se tezaab milta hai.
Benzoic acid (benzenecarboxylic acid): methylbenzene tezaabi KMnO4 ya K2Cr2O7 se aasani se oxidise hota hai: C6H5CH3 + 3[O] -> C6H5COOH + H2O (KMnO4, halka H2SO4, garmi).

blocks.alt: Do mua'adle, teer ke oopar K2Cr2O7/dil. H2SO4 aur neeche Heat. Ethanol, CH3-CH2-OH, + 2[O] se ethanoic acid, CH3-C(=O)-OH, + H2O. Ethanal, CH3-C(=O)-H, + [O] se ethanoic acid.
blocks.caption: a) Ethanol aur ethanal ki oxidation se ethanoic acid (kitab ke PDF safha 108 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ne ethanal wale mua'adle mein daen taraf '+ H2O' bhi likha hai, jis se mua'adla balance nahi rehta (baen 4 H, daen 6 H). Sahi: CH3CHO + [O] -> CH3COOH, paani nahi banta; khaaka isi tarah bana hai.

blocks.alt: Teen mua'adle. CH3-CN + 2H2O + HCl -> CH3-C(=O)-OH + NH4Cl. CH3-CN + H2O + NaOH -> CH3-C(=O)-O-Na+ + NH3 (gas). CH3-C(=O)-O-Na+ + HCl -> CH3-C(=O)-OH + NaCl.
blocks.caption: b) Tezaab aur alkali mein ethanenitrile ki hydrolysis, aur namak ko tezaabi banana (kitab ke PDF safha 109 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Teen mua'adle. Ethyl ethanoate, CH3-C(=O)-O-CH2-CH3, + H2O(l), equilibrium teeron par H3O+, se CH3-C(=O)-OH + CH3-CH2-OH. Ethyl ethanoate + NaOH(aq) se CH3-C(=O)-O-Na+ + CH3-CH2-OH; 'Bond breaks' wala teer C=O carbon aur O ke darmiyan bond ki taraf. CH3-C(=O)-O-Na+ + HCl se CH3-C(=O)-OH + NaCl.
blocks.caption: c) Tezaab aur alkali mein ethyl ethanoate ki hydrolysis, aur namak ko tezaabi banana (kitab ke PDF safha 109 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Tezaab ke saath ester ki hydrolysis ulat sakti hai, is liye equilibrium ke teer hain. Alkali (NaOH) ke saath bana tezaab foran namak (CH3COO-Na+) ban jata hai aur wapas ester nahi banta, is liye yeh reaction mukammal hota hai. Kitab ne yahan bhi equilibrium ke teer chhape hain; khaake mein sahi aik-rukha teer hai. 'Bond breaks' batata hai ke ester ka C(=O)-O bond toot'ta hai.

blocks.alt: Methylbenzene (CH3 wala benzene ring) + 3[O], teer ke oopar KMnO4 aur neeche dil. H2SO4; Heat, se benzene carboxylic acid (COOH wala benzene ring) + H2O.
blocks.caption: d) Methylbenzene ki oxidation se benzenecarboxylic acid (benzoic acid) (kitab ke PDF safha 109 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Tezaabi K2Cr2O7 (reflux par) se propan-1-ol ki oxidation ka mua'adla likhein.
blocks.explanation: CH3CH2CH2OH + 2[O] -> CH3CH2COOH + H2O (propanoic acid; pehle propanal banta hai).

blocks.prompt: (i) CH3CH2CN ki hydrolysis, (ii) ethylbenzene ki oxidation, (iii) ethyl ethanoate ki hydrolysis ke products aur mua'adlat batayein.
blocks.explanation: (i) CH3CH2CN + 2H2O + HCl -> CH3CH2COOH + NH4Cl (propanoic acid). (ii) C6H5CH2CH3 + 6[O] -> C6H5COOH + CO2 + 2H2O (benzoic acid; KMnO4, garmi). (iii) CH3COOCH2CH3 + H2O <=> CH3COOH + CH3CH2OH (ethanoic acid aur ethanol).

items: Primary alcohols ya aldehydes oxidise karein (reflux, tezaabi dichromate).
Nitriles ya esters hydrolyse karein (alkali, phir tezaab).
Methylbenzene ko benzoic acid mein oxidise karein.
